data.narrative:
Photonic Inc, a Series E quantum computing company founded by Stephanie Simmons and Michael Thewalt, is valued within a landscape of 9 comparable firms—3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 6 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Stage-progression analysis applies to this valuation. Using total capital raised of $375M CAD as a proxy baseline and adjusting to $465M USD equivalent, a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E advancement yields an implied valuation of $651M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable; while 6 same-sector quantum computing comparables exist, none satisfied filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) with sufficient density to support independent median calibration. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce excessive dispersion noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $553M to $749M, centered on $651M. This single-method result reflects meaningful constraint: the quantum computing peer set lacks sufficient same-stage density for cross-sectional validation. Key uncertainties include absence of recent financing rounds among the identified comparable set and limited public market depth in quantum hardware. Further triangulation would require either additional Series E private quantum firm data or forward revenue/cash-burn metrics not present in current inputs.
